issues: With a slight front tilt (rotateX 18°, rotateY −12°) the layers just floated forward a little; it read as 'cards lifting', not an exploded view
All eight layers were slices of the same grey placeholder dashboard with no sense of what each layer was, so taking it apart said nothing about the product
Once exploded, the layers were darkened by a cool overlay and the white cards looked grey and dirty
The reassembly ended with a 2f screen shake, against the 'keep the camera steady' rule for product films
changes: Porcelain look (cool white, cobalt) with a three-quarter axonometric camera (rotateX 54°, rotateZ −34°): the page lies flat and layers stack up along its normal, the camera orbits +10° during the hover and pulls back to make room for the stack

A purpose-built five-layer support desk 'Relay': sidebar, volume chart, AI assistant, metric cards and command bar, with dashed slots left on the base plate; layers further back on the page rise higher so none hides another
Keynote-style numbered callouts: anchors are 3D-projected every frame and follow the orbit; in two columns, leader lines draw then a 44px title and 30px note rise, staggered 6f

Rhythm: a spring explode staggered 5f (one visible overshoot), a hover hold, callouts out, a reverse ease-in slam, then an 8px sink-and-rebound with a tightening contact shadow instead of a shake, and one light sweep
At the end the camera slides right and 'Built in layers.' rises word by word top left with a subtitle, so the last frame is a poster; length 150f to 170f
